description: Clone the Dify repo and start its Docker Compose stack with a loopback-only override (nginx published on 127.0.0.1:8088 instead of 0.0.0.0:80). In Dify Settings → Model Provider, add Ollama with base URL http://host.docker.internal:11434. This pulls several multi-GB images.

steps.description: Make sure the AI Chat plugin's Ollama is running on 127.0.0.1:11434 (start it if installed). Install the AI Chat plugin first if this reports it missing.
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434; nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; fi; echo "Ollama not reachable on 127.0.0.1:11434 — install/run the AI Chat plugin first (it sets up Ollama with no root)."
mkdir -p "$HOME/.mobilessh/dify"; cd "$HOME/.mobilessh/dify"; test -d dify || git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/langgenius/dify.git

steps.description: Create .env and a docker-compose.override.yaml that (a) rebinds nginx to loopback 127.0.0.1:8088 only (ports: !override — requires Docker Compose v2.24.4+) and (b) gives the api/worker containers host-gateway access so they can reach the host Ollama. Re-run safe.
steps.run:
cd "$HOME/.mobilessh/dify/dify/docker"; cp -n .env.example .env; cat > docker-compose.override.yaml <<'YML'
services:
  nginx:
    ports: !override
      - "127.0.0.1:8088:80"
  api:
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
  worker:
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
YML

steps.description: Start the Dify stack (downloads several images on first run).
steps.run: cd "$(eval echo ~"${SUDO_USER:-$USER}")/.mobilessh/dify/dify/docker"; docker compose up -d; for i in $(seq 1 90); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8088/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "Dify still starting — give it a minute, then open it and create the admin account at /install."

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the Dify stack and its volumes (accounts, apps, data).
uninstall.run: cd "$(eval echo ~"${SUDO_USER:-$USER}")/.mobilessh/dify/dify/docker" 2>/dev/null && docker compose down -v 2>/dev/null || true
